topic: Google fixed more Chrome bugs in June than over the past two years, thanks to AI
headline: AI Boosts Chrome Bug Fixes
caption: As a full stack engineer, I find this update fascinating. Leveraging AI for bug detection speeds up the process significantly and reduces manual overhead. It’s exciting to see how machine learning is transforming debugging from a reactive to a proactive process 🚀. This change not only improves browser stability but also hints at a future where AI actively maintains code health across complex projects. Staying updated with these advancements helps us build more reliable and secure apps. Curious to see how AI continues to reshape our workflows! #WebDevelopment #AIFuture #CodingLife
